# `aitbc dashboard shop`

Show the shop dashboard with GPUs, offers, jobs, and earnings.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dashboard shop [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--miner-id` | text | — | no | Miner ID for this shop (optional; defaults to island id) |
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | no | Number of market offers to show |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dashboard shop
```
